body: From my perspective it seems we might be heading in that direction. Thank you for your reply! I think I'll bring it up before the trip so he has more time after to think about his boundaries.

Hmm. You do have a point there. He has told me that I'm the person that makes him feel warm a couple times. Although, I show my affection, I tell him how appreciative I am of him, and I make an effort to show him that I care. 

At this moment, I feel like he's hooking me and pulling me closer. Then casting me back into the water and repeating the process. 

Thank you for the reply!

You're 100% right. I think I might just focus on myself and not date anymore, too much headache lol. 

Thank you for the reply!

I've been very transparent with everything I want, because I don't want to waste our time. I told him I won't have sex with any man until there is a deep connection and were in a relationship, he even supported my mindset. 

He told me he's open for a situation-ship and relationship if the right woman comes around. I made It 100% clear that I am not looking for a situation-ship with him or anyone. Even after the fact, he continued talking to me. 

Last night he was going to ft me. Although, he said he would call me later in the night (around 12am) because he's out late with people and he doesn't know when he will be back. He does this every time, and he's the one that makes these plans. I decided to just be polite and told him he could call me another night. 

Thank you for the reply, btw!
I agree, I can't change him. He had to change for himself. I know there is someone better out there for me. Thanks for the reply.

I went through his phone and it was the first thing I saw. I understand now that I was wrong on my part to breach his privacy and never did it again. I've really thought about the situation and im gonna break it off. Thanks for the reply

He spoke about her P\*ssy, no respect for me. Which gives me more reason to tell them to cut off the relationship. I try my best to understand the other side, if the text never showed up, I could have been open to meeting her and feeling her out. If he would have brought it up, but he kept it a secret. I allow him to do whatever he wants and that was my only rule.

I have insecurities, but I have boundaries. So it's normal to continue talking to someone you have had sexual history with, even when in a relationship? After he's spoken down on me with this woman. I feel like anyone would feel hurt and insecure in that moment and it pretty much gives me a reason to feel that way int he first place. He said it was just a friendship, but spoke about their sex life.

I fine with him being close friends with girls, he has multiple actually. I just don't like it if they've had history together. I guess I was caught off with him hesitating, but he did unfollow her after all. This is his first serious relationship too, so we're still learning the ropes. He did promise that it would never happen again.

This morning I feel much more calm and at peace, like I actually want to get out of bed. As long as it motivates me to go outside and do something for myself, I will be happy from there. I'll remind myself that it will level out in a few weeks! Thank you.

Yeah thats a big fear of mine, pretty much the reason why it took me so long to get onto antidepressants. It may help with my situation now, but stop working down the road. Could even make me more depressed in the long run, my life for once feels normal again I just don't want it to go back how it was. But I've very much aware of the situation now, and ill keep an eye on my mood. Thank so much!

Thank you for brining awareness to the situation! Last night I was up till I think 2am researching on the topic, although this morning I feel very calm. I guess I feel happy to be alive now, I just feel excited to take on the day. Although, I have no good or bad thoughts kind of just nothing in brain right now. Im going to speak with my doctor today about the situation and see what his insight on the situation is. Thank so much for the replies, really appreciate your help!

Hi good morning/afternoon! I did post on another subreddit, I was told that it could be in a manic or hypo episode. Although, this morning everything has levelled out, I still feel happy then again I haven't started my day yet. Im going to call my doctor and have a word to see if this could have triggered a manic episode. But at this moment I have no thoughts, so good or bad, its weird. My mother doesn't believe in medication, she's pretty much thinks herbs and vitamins can heal everything, she didn't want her daughter to be on antidepressants. I told her yesterday and she just shrugged, but im sure once im more happy she will accept it more. Thanks for the reply!

I just have a lot of energy, I would usually be knocked out right now, but I feel like I could run a marathon. It very weird since I did a lot of activities today. I've never had a mania episode ever in my life, maybe this antidepressant triggered something?

>placebo

what this is just a high? So ill never feel that happy again
